audit_item: M0.1 / sourced cashflow exact aggregation and Decimal boundaries
finding: Batch and online cashflow sums could silently round mixed-scale finite values under caller Decimal precision; withdrawal unary negation also rounded before aggregation; overflow could leak raw decimal exceptions; wide exponent alignment could cause excessive allocation.
change: Both report paths now use an exact Decimal adder with operand-derived local precision, a 4096-digit alignment cap, stable MetricsError mapping, and copy_negate() for context-independent withdrawal signing. Regressions cover precision-3 addition and withdrawal signing, precision-cap rejection, and sum overflow.
